stem.text: A diving board of length $5.0\,\text{m}$ is hinged at one end and supported $2.0\,\text{m}$ from this end by a spring of spring constant $10\,\text{kN m}^{-1}$. A child of mass $40\,\text{kg}$ stands at the far end of the board.

stem.alt: Diving board hinged at its right end and supported by a spring. A child stands on the far left end. Labels: mass of child 40 kg, diving board, spring, hinge, 2.0 m, 5.0 m.

stem.text: What is the extra compression of the spring caused by the child standing on the end of the board?
